title: 2020-21 Panini Prizm Pink Prizm #210 DeMar DeRozan San Antonio Spurs Card
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText:
This 2020-21 Panini Prizm sports trading card features DeMar DeRozan of the San Antonio Spurs in the National Basketball Association (NBA). The card is part of the base set and has a card number of 210. It also has a Pink Prizm parallel/variety and is from the 2020-21 season. The card is not autographed and is unsigned. 

The card is a great addition to any basketball trading card collection and is perfect for fans of DeMar DeRozan or the San Antonio Spurs. It is a must-have for collectors looking for a complete set of the 2020-21 Panini Prizm collection. Get your hands on this card today and add it to your collection!
